summary: John's 9th-great-grandfather; born at Oberbrombach, baptized at Niederbrombach 1616.
bio: Baptized 26 May 1616 at Niederbrombach, born at Oberbrombach; married 9 Jan 1642 at Lauterecken Elisabetha Birgert of Fockenberg-Limbach, daughter of Conrad Birgert; died 29 Apr 1671 at Berschweiler.
